title: A Precise and Exact Gamow’s Formula Adapted to the Classical Mechanics Context of the Rh=ct Thermodynamic Quantum Cosmology
content: We propose to heuristically fix the constant radiation of Gamow formula, which we then demonstrate, to adapt it consistently to the Rh=ct thermodynamic quantum cosmology witch is in the field of classic mechanics at any cosmic time tRh=1/H where H is the Hubble parameter. It has the potential to offer an alternative theoretical framework in which the validity of Gamow's formula could be reevaluated and tested.
